title: Show HN: Huzzah – a novel approach to coding with AI
summary: Huzzah is an experimental editor that lets users write pseudocode, which is then synchronized to real source code on save, with the pseudocode persisted as a record of intent. It aims to reduce the tedium of full-sentence prompts for coding agents while avoiding the complexity limits of agent-based coding. Currently a proof of concept, it offers a novel middle ground between manual coding and agent-driven development.
